entries.4dbf1761440f5318: Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co.,Ltd. is a stainless steel maker with an integrated production system from raw materials to products: it produces plates and strip of stainless steel, heat-resistant steel and high-nickel alloys at its Kawasaki Works, and smelts the raw material ferronickel at its Oeyama Works.
entries.58673ef5132b6e0b: Revenue comes from sales of stainless steel plates and their processed products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥150,866 million, down 12.3% year on year due to a decrease in sales volume.

entries.600c704a9dec90ee: It has an integrated system, handling ferronickel smelting from the Oeyama Works through rolling at the Kawasaki Works. Of revenue of ¥150,866 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, ¥112,606 million was for Japan, so transactions with domestic customers are central.

entries.dde81a31c3b6c3be: The company has formulated the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2026-2028' covering fiscal 2026 through fiscal 2028, and states its target image as 'a resilient company that continues to evolve by taking on new domains as a top supplier in the nickel high-alloy and stainless steel markets.' The 3 basic strategies are: exploring market needs in new domains and developing and providing the necessary items; pursuing technology and building a production system able to meet all needs; and establishing a sustainable management base that responds to changes in the environment.
